subject: Some dynamic UI is not running

messages.author: 40b63348dbcb447d
messages.subject: Some dynamic UI is not running
parts:
Hi,

I have two controls that depends on a .rdata file. Here is my simplified code:


ui.R

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(  
  sidebarPanel(
    uiOutput("choiceControl"),
    ...))


server.R

shinyServer(function(input, output) {

  load("dataset.rdata") # the object name is "dataset"
  
  output$choiceControl <- reactiveUI(function() {
    choice.list <- seq_along(dataset)
    names(choice.list) <- names(dataset)
    selectInput("choice", "Choices", choice.list)
  })
}

What is the problem of my code? Thank you.

Thanks!

messages.author: 48f24841e806e6c6
messages.subject: Re: Some dynamic UI is not running
parts:
Turns out this was a bug in the glimmer shiny server software and not
in shiny itself. The shiny server was neglecting to set the LANG
environment variable prior to forking the R shiny app. That's why it
works locally but not on glimmer.

I imaging a shiny server restart on glimmer will fix this.
